egress_policy: only explicit admitted outputs/effects or bounded GLM inference requests cross outward and remain bound to canonical causal turn/effect receipts; Kubernetes reference deployment starts default-deny and requires an exact reviewed allow policy; stale/replayed/unknown/unauthorized effects fail closed

needle_runtime: deterministic routing/pressure hint in the real hook turn path; collision/unresolved/effect-aware; never grants permissions
